SELECT 
    b.striker AS player_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs 
    ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
    AND b.over_id = bs.over_id

SELECT 
    pm.player_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played
FROM ipl.main.player_match pm
JOIN ipl.main.match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season_id = 5
GROUP BY pm.player_id

SELECT 
    wt.player_out AS player_id,
    COUNT(*) AS times_out
FROM ipl.main.wicket_taken wt
JOIN ipl.main.match m ON wt.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season_id = 5
GROUP BY wt.player_out
ORDER BY

WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker AS player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id

WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker AS player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.match_id) AS matches_batted
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    J

WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker AS player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.match_id) AS matches_batted
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    J

WITH player_runs AS (

    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id

WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker AS player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b

        ON b.match_id

SELECT
